partners.mechanism_chain: PSTPIP1 (HGNC:9036) —DISRUPTS→ Regulation of inflammatory signaling (GO:0050727); Regulation of inflammatory signaling (GO:0050727) —LEADS_TO→ Hyperzincemia with functional zinc depletion (MONDO:0011174); NLRP3 (HGNC:11456) —DISRUPTS→ NLRP3 inflammasome activation (GO:0032670); NLRP3 inflammasome activation (GO:0032670) —PRODUCES→ IL-1 beta (CHEBI:17700); IL-1 beta (CHEBI:17700) —LEADS_TO→ Muckle-Wells syndrome (MONDO:0008633); Regulation of inflammatory signaling (GO:0050727) —DECREASES→ NLRP3 inflammasome activation (GO:0032670); NLRP3 inflammasome activation (GO:0032670) —LEADS_TO→ Hyperzincemia with functional zinc depletion (MONDO:0011174). Haploinsufficiency of PSTPIP1 (Disease A) leads to impaired regulation of inflammatory signaling, which in turn contributes to the phenotype of hyperzincemia with functional zinc depletion. Gain-of-function mutations in NLRP3 (Disease B) lead to constitutive activation of the NLRP3 inflammasome, resulting in increased production of IL-1 beta and the phenotype of Muckle-Wells syndrome. The convergence occurs because dysregulation in the broader inflammatory signaling pathway (affected by PSTPIP1) can either directly or indirectly impact the NLRP3 inflammasome activation (affected by NLRP3), and conversely, excessive IL-1 beta production can exacerbate systemic inflammation, potentially affecting zinc homeostasis.

Concurrently, loss-of-function variants in HMOX1 impair heme catabolism, which in turn can negatively affect zinc homeostasis, potentially exacerbating or contributing to the phenotype of functional zinc depletion.
